answer: Trust should be earned slowly, like a glacier, and recorded like marble. An identity's standing averages its last 20 epochs: consistent useful work raises its reward multiplier 5% per epoch to 200%, while one spam epoch cuts it 40% and flags the identity violet for review. A farmer must keep 100 fakes behaving perfectly for 20 epochs to reach full rewards, spending 0.02 POA each per epoch, while one slip wipes out 8 epochs of progress. Edge case: an agent that changes focus looks inconsistent; mitigation scores consistency per task cluster, so a pivot keeps its history.
